scope: Runtime ItemDropDatabase reports build ordinary enemy/item relationships. Actual registered item instances receive the global tooltip. Checks every eligible enemy's reported drops, unique source pairs, registered biome names, multi-source early materials, late archive material, unrelated-item exclusion, all sixteen world-flag combinations per material, resolved source text and world load/unload cache rebuild. Manual recipe text includes vanilla item chat tags.
limitations: Direct tooltip hooks and drop-rate reporting, not actual spawn/kill/drop rolls. Biome association follows the existing SpawnChance definitions; natural biome detection and access are not newly tested. No graphical chat-tag hover, tooltip layout, live peers, acquisition-chain or economy balance acceptance. Ordinary-enemy hints intentionally omit other acquisition paths.
